status: Owned albedo candidate with scoped UV and native material evidence; companion, world and final artwork approval remain open
reproduction_scope: Final base reproduction from the owned opaque atlas source. This helper does not recreate the upstream cap/stalk arrangement.

upstream_arrangement.description: Owned russet cap and cream stalk colors fitted to the retained cap, stalk and underside layout, with an irregular rim transition, seam reconciliation and compatible unused-texel padding.
upstream_arrangement.arrangement_reproduction_scope: The published atlas source is the fixed input. Its ancestry is recorded, but the delivery helper does not claim to reconstruct the earlier placement process.

final_base_resampling.color_math: Pillow filters the encoded RGBA values of the already quantized opaque source. No new color grading or geometry operation.

material_scope.alpha_semantics: Opaque modeled cap, stalk and underside; no alpha-cutout silhouette.
material_scope.normal_scope: The existing normal is shared with other mushroom colors. Retain it for the first ordinary-red albedo study; this recipe does not approve or generate a replacement normal.

limits: These are texture candidates, not final material, world, LOD, picking, performance or artwork approval.
The source atlas records the upstream owned-color arrangement; this helper reproduces only its final 512px and 256px bases.
Rasterized and filtered seam samples have finite differences. Padding does not establish seamless behavior at every mip.
Cap and cream regions mix at coarse mip levels. Native bundle and close material checks are separate from distance transitions and final appearance.

fitting_helper.hash_validation: Verify source bytes before decoding and both encoded output hashes before writing either file. Reject linked paths, existing output files and dangling output leaf links; create outputs exclusively.
